subject.title: feat(agents): surface watched-session awareness to the model

question: Should full main-session prompts automatically include the identifiers and display titles of every ambiently watched same-agent group or topic session once parity and real behavior proof are complete?
rationale: The implementation preserves the existing read policy but changes what session-state context is proactively sent to the model on every full prompt; that user-facing privacy and product trade-off needs explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Accept bounded prompt awareness
options.body: Keep the capped, sanitized watched-session section after fixing compaction parity and confirming the visible DM-to-group workflow with real proof.

options.title: Keep awareness tool-discoverable
options.body: Retain corrected tool copy and recall guidance but omit automatic watched-session identifiers from the system prompt.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded prompt awareness
recommendation.body: Keep the capped, sanitized watched-session section after fixing compaction parity and confirming the visible DM-to-group workflow with real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged ambient-watch implementation defines the existing state and visibility boundary that this prompt behavior surfaces.
